title: Capture CSV rerun completed replacements
summary: CSV rerun replace-final rows now preserve per-row completed destinations, append clean replacements to the operator completed jobs JSONL, and expose row-level destination summaries in the rerun overview.
reason: Replace-completed reruns can span multiple final destinations from audit CSV data; the previous overview and completed output capture were centered on a single configured destination root.
behavior_before: CSV rerun planning computed final output paths from one configured outsource root, and replace-final rerun sidecar promotion did not mirror the replacement into State/Completed/completed_jobs.jsonl.
behavior_after: CSV rerun planning honors row-level completed destination fields such as plex_planned_path, records the source field, appends clean replace-final results to the completed jobs manifest, and reports destination summary/sample targets in the overview.
rollback_plan: Revert the touched rerun entrypoint, rerun results read model, WebView rerun overview, focused tests, generated summaries, and this change packet.
